decisions.decision: New ACTION_REASON_FAULT_BLOCKED = 11 for capability-blocked player requests

decisions.rejected: Only the fault device, or separate entries

decisions.decision: Server merges an identical refusal into the device newest entry with attempts + 1

decisions.decision: A refusal that records a device feed entry commits a new coordination revision (rejectPlayerAction), for both fault-block and 040 request-time refusals
